original_value: Compact 24-input, 24-output HDMI matrix switcher built for command centers, live events, and multi-screen show control. Supports independent routing, front-panel presets, and remote management over Ethernet. Designed for rack-mounted AV installations rather than consumer storage or graphics workloads.

result.paraphrase: Rack-mount AV HDMI matrix switcher with 24 inputs and 24 outputs, intended for command centers, live events, and multi-screen show control. It offers independent routing, front-panel presets, and Ethernet-based remote management. Meant for professional installations, not consumer storage or graphics workloads.
